description: Argentina's open data portal for agriculture, livestock and fisheries. The portal page says it offers datasets on agriculture, livestock and fisheries for download in interoperable, reusable formats and lists 152 datasets, 137 from the Secretariat of Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries, 13 from INDEC and others from AFIP and FAO, tagged with topics such as harvested and sown area, yields, soybean, dairy and livestock movements and the 2002 agricultural census. Downloads are free. Coverage is Argentina, often by province or department. Caveats: the licence of each dataset is not shown on the listing read, and update dates vary. For simulation it gives crop areas and yields and livestock movements for one of the world's largest grain exporters, to model how droughts or floods cut output and exports. A related catalogue record is the Argentina national map of crops.
